frames.label: Map_Sonic_071E
frames.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Draw ONE original 16-bit pixel sprite of MICA the jade pangolin on transparent background. Image 1 is this frame's stock native pose: match its exact stride phase, limb/boot positions, rotation, framing and silhouette size, redrawing all anatomy as MICA; never recolour Sonic. Image 2 is MICA concept (jade form). Images 3/4 are approved flat WALK and RUN style anchors. MICA: rounded overlapping jade pangolin scales, small round ears, long tapered scaled tail, cream muzzle/belly, white gloves, coral hiking boots with tan lug soles. No Sonic spines, ears, face or shoes. Frame run-up45-00: 45-degree uphill, head upper-left and feet lower-right. Keep the native rotated pose, do NOT turn upright. Preserve the native phase of the circular coral boot-speed streak, with anatomically connected bent limbs. New drawing consistent with the flat pilot, compact crisp pixel clusters, dark native one-pixel outline, restrained scale highlights. One character only; no ground, shadow, text, grid or extra frames.
frames.reduction: largest alpha component; Lanczos to existing box; fixed palette indices; inside outline; support normalization (at most 10% shrink around unchanged hotspot or transparent right padding)
